status_values.DRAFT_FOR_ROOT_REVIEW_NO_REAL_RUNS: code, protocol and toy tests only; no real RNA value is read and nothing is fitted
status_values.FROZEN_PVH_PILOT_AUTHORIZED: one atlas run, one RNA extraction run and one exploratory fit run, each with its fixed run ID

question: In one nucleus (PVH), what does public existing data say about which molecular populations were collected from parabrachial (PB) versus spinal cord (SC) retrograde labelling, and can raw nuclear gene counts predict the collection label across sex-swapped pools better than simple controls?
not_claimed: absence of projection to any other target, or dual projection
individual-animal generalisation (mice were pooled; 4-10 per pool)
spatial position, 3D geometry, axon paths, synapses or circuits
new discovery or novelty of any kind

source.study: Li, Resch et al. 2026, PVH spatial and projection atlas (Cell Reports 45:116904; PMC13007250; GEO GSE303256; Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.15983704)

label_meaning.PB: nucleus belongs to the author's PB-projecting retrograde collection group
label_meaning.SC: nucleus belongs to the author's SC-projecting retrograde collection group
label_meaning.endpoint: P(PB collection group | nucleus is in this PB-or-SC collected cohort). Not a projection probability.

atlas.cohort: original-study nuclei only: PB 598 + SC 627 = 1225; the 2498 reused SC nuclei (Winter 2023, Beine 2022) are excluded
atlas.content: one record per nucleus (object, cell ID, source study, object batch, encoded pool if known, sex if known, positive collection target, AUTHOR_INFERRED type) plus counts by AUTHOR_INFERRED type x positive collection target, by pool and by object batch
atlas.nulls: individual animal, measured location/coordinates and other-target status stay null; no coordinates are invented
atlas.author_inferred_type: predicted.celltype from the author object is an inferred label, used only to group atlas counts; never a fit feature or gold label
atlas.counts_meaning: sampling counts within collected nuclei, not prevalence
atlas.outputs: atlas_nuclei.csv, atlas_counts.csv, evidence_graph.json (nodes, edges, provenance), RUN_COMPLETE.json

fit_cohort.rule: manifest rows with original_study = true and exact_first_MUX_barcode_join = true (GEO GEX GSM9117450)
fit_cohort.cell_key: object (PB or SC) + exact cell ID
fit_cohort.pools_are_not_animals: each encoded pool combines 4-10 mice; only one pool per sex x target

extraction.method: own base-R reader (Rscript --vanilla analysis/pvh_population_extract.R); no author code, no Seurat or other package installed or loaded
checks: object SHA-256 equals the pin before reading
assay is RNA (not prediction.score.celltype); layer is counts (not data or scale.data)
counts are finite, >= 0 and whole numbers; the data layer, if present, is not identical
layer cell order taken from the object's cell map or layer dimnames and must equal meta.data row names exactly
layer gene IDs taken from the object's feature map for the counts layer or layer dimnames; counts must match
every cohort cell found exactly once; no other cells exported
extraction.outputs: per object: genes.txt, cells.tsv, triplets.tsv (gene index, cell index, count) for the cohort cells only; receipt.tsv

features.allowed: raw RNA counts only, on the exact common gene ID panel (intersection of PB and SC count-layer gene IDs)
features.excluded_genes: Reviewed reference.forbidden_name token rules plus ERCC[-_] prefixes and exact reporter/spike tokens DsRed, BFP, EBFP, EBFP2, mRFP, mRFP1, TotalSeq and HTO. Every excluded common gene ID is listed. Native Creb/Creld/Gfpt symbols remain eligible.
features.transform: per cell: count / total count over the common panel x 10,000, then log1p
features.selection: top min(500, number of non-constant genes) by variance on TRAINING cells only; ties broken by gene ID (lexical)
features.scaling: StandardScaler fitted on training cells only

folds.meaning: Cross-sex pool transfer within the same first-MUX sequencing run. Only one preparation pool per sex x target; pool/preparation effects cannot be disentangled. No individual-animal claim.

methods.logistic_frozen_recipe: L2 logistic C=0.1, lbfgs, max_iter 2000, tol 1e-6, seed 20261112; alpha 0.1 shrinkage; reuses fixed C/alpha, not cortical coefficients; CP10k/HVG preprocessing is an explicitly declared new RNA-modality adapter
methods.hgbt_fixed: the fixed HistGradientBoostingClassifier structure from analysis/paired_projection_nonlinear.py (100 trees, depth 2, 4 leaves, min leaf 20, L2 1.0, rate 0.05, no early stopping, seed 20261112); alpha 0.1
methods.molecular_knn31: KNN k=31 on scaled selected genes; alpha 0.1
methods.gene_copy_1nn: label of the single nearest training nucleus on scaled selected genes; alpha 0.5
methods.technical_logistic: L2 logistic C=0.1 on log1p(common-panel library total) and log1p(detected common genes); alpha 0.1
methods.location_comparator: NONE AVAILABLE: no measured positions exist in these RNA data
methods.shrinkage: p' = (1 - alpha) p + alpha q, q = pool-balanced training PB rate
methods.weights: pool-balanced sample weights (1/n_pool, mean-normalised) for logistic and HGBT; KNN and copy unweighted
methods.pool_weighted_knn31: Same 31 nearest training nuclei as molecular_knn31; average labels using inverse training-pool size, then alpha 0.1 shrinkage. Added before any expression inspection to strengthen the pool-balanced control.

metrics.primary: log loss (clip 1e-6) and Brier: mean over cells within each test pool, then mean over the test pools of a fold, then mean over the two folds
metrics.reported: every method, per pool, per fold, macro; AUROC per fold as a descriptive number only
metrics.not_done: no cell-level p-values, no promotion or gate regardless of score

fit_run.saved: protocol snapshot, STARTED, cohort, common panel, per-fold selected genes, scalers, priors, training cell IDs, model artifacts, keyed out-of-fold raw and shrunk probabilities, metrics, RUN_COMPLETE; complete hash-pinned fold inference states and feature-only serialization roundtrip checks

pins_checked_before_any_data_is_read: protocol status FROZEN_PVH_PILOT_AUTHORIZED, committed and unmodified
canonical code and extractor committed and unmodified
RDS, manifest and metadata SHA-256 as above
fit run: the completed extraction run's receipt and file hashes, and the cohort hash
